mails.subject: Private opportunity, strictly time sensitive
mails.body:
Hello,

I will be direct. I manage a small private fund and we have a place open in a closed round for a digital asset product that returns a fixed 4.2 percent per month. I selected your organisation from a list of growing businesses in Copenhagen.

The minimum is 5,000 EUR, and funds are held by an independent custodian. Past participants have been paid every month since January. We only take eight more participants, and the round closes on Sunday night.

I can send the documents on request, but to reserve your place I need a first transfer before the close. Details of the account will follow in my next message.

Please do not forward this email. It is intended for the recipient only.

Best regards,
Oliver Brandt
Tidewater Capital Partners
mails.justification: Investment scam promising fixed monthly returns, sent late at night to a stranger. The sender has no relationship with the space and the message was never requested.
